quotes.text: It's really hard to compete on best product and it's really hard to compete on operational efficiency. But everybody can do customer intimacy if they want to.
The objection to all of this is how do you scale it? I don't think you do scale it. You scale it with having your antenna up and trying a couple of times a week to do that for people.
If it means I grow a little slower, then so be it. If it means that the robots beat me, then I would rather lose this way than win that way.
